includes: Most taxes and fees included in package price
blurb: Friendly Planet Travel offers travel packages that bundle flights, hotels, and other components into one price. They provide a price guarantee and allow changes or customizations to bookings with certain policies. Travel protection plans are available for purchase to cover trip cancellation, delays, medical emergencies, and more.
extraNote: Price may change only if you request changes, new government taxes or vendor charges increase · No fees or penalties for changes until final payment due date (75 days prior to departure) under Carefree Booking policy · Changes after final payment due date may incur fees or be impossible · Advance seat reservation fees not included in package price · Travel protection plan must be purchased before final payment; some plans must be purchased within 21 days of deposit
